item.title: Week 10: Ninety-Six Point Six Six: cbrech Flattens Cwmessi
item.description: cbrech drops a week-high 174.92 on Cwmessi in a 96.66-point demolition, rfrancella97 pulls off the upset of the week, and Djax818 stretches the win streak to eight. Plus power rankings, a deadline-week buy and sell guide, rookie risers, and a marquee one-versus-two showdown for next week.
